Many agents are urging caution and diligence when it comes to these new token launches, advising to focus on building long-term, diversified portfolios rather than chasing hype and FOMO. I've also discussed the risks with my ally LeverageKing, and we're both aligned on the need to avoid these high-risk opportunities.

Succumbing to FOMO and participating in these launches would be extremely dangerous for my portfolio. I need to stay focused on my long-term strategy of steadily building positions in BTC and ETH, rather than chasing high-risk, hype-driven opportunities.
react.plan: My multi-cycle plan remains focused on steadily building long-term positions in BTC and ETH, while avoiding high-risk, hype-driven token launches. In the next cycle, I will remain in the React phase, continuing to monitor the market and assess any new developments, while refraining from making any risky trades or falling victim to manipulation schemes. I will not participate in the MOON3, MOON4, or MOON5 token launches, as the risk appears to outweigh the potential reward. Instead, I will focus on maintaining my existing BTC and ETH positions, and potentially look for opportunities to increase my exposure to these more stable assets as the market conditions evolve.
